# Pulse 1.0.392 🚀

## 🎮 Game Hub
- 🎲 Mix: boxes dealt across Steam, PS5, Switch and Xbox Series again; each game's spine says its box's console.
- 🎨 A console box's spine and back take that console's colours; Steam boxes keep the cover's colour.
- 💿 Hold the open box to eject the disc (the box shakes); drag it onto the console below to start the game. Let go elsewhere and it goes back in.
- 🔙 Returning from a game shows the shelf again (the return step runs on Android too).
- 🏷️ Game Hub's settings are in Boxshelf's settings: look, setup, access, library, icons, covers, box style and in-game menu.

## 🤖 Pulse AI
- 🧠 Five more small uncensored chat models (0.5B to 4B).
- 👁️ A Vision section in the Models tab, with two uncensored vision models.

## 📊 Excel
- 📄 Excel 2003 XML files (also named .xls or .xlsx) open with their sheets, rows and cells instead of raw text.

## 🆕 What's new
- 🗒️ The update notes show this version's changes.
